title: Appearance refresh result (version 3)
description: The JSON-encoded string an AGS app returns for ["appearance-refresh", "<genHash>"]. Exactly three shapes are valid: applied, deferred or failed. Every response names a generation hash, and the caller MUST reject a response whose applied/genHash value differs from the requested genHash. The old v2 boolean ack {"ok":true} is invalid because it cannot name the generation that was applied.

genHash.description: A lowercase 64-character SHA-256 generation hash. It must equal the genHash in the originating request.

applied.description: The exact generation the app resolved, validated and installed.

genHash.description: The requested generation that was not applied yet.

retryable.description: true means the next trigger retries this generation; false is terminal for this generation.

genHash.description: The requested generation whose apply failed.
